Introduction

This document outlines the equipment 
inspection list I1, which must be carried out 
every two months as indicated by M2 in the title 
block.

This Fan 
is used for 
for supplying the boiler 
with combustion air

The first draft initiated by eng. Fawzy 
Ahmed Bsiouny, tested at 03 
Nov. 
2003, 
reviewed by maintenance 
director: eng. Saad Mostafa, revised by EDEPCo. quality control eng. Samir Abdel Gilel, 
accepted by maintenance general director eng. 
Ali 
Mostafa Al-lithy 
and approved by eng. 
Awad Mohammed Fathy Soliman Head Sector of 
TALKHA power station.
Technical specification of the Fan
Safety Precautions

A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,

Safety fence 
 (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,

Wear safety 
 helmet, and safety shoes ... etc
Isolate the circuit breaker for the air fan

items:

sections.text: Tools and Equipment
Work to be Carried Out
Setting

rows: Listen and check any abnormal noise

items:
Check the front /rear bearing and replace the 
 defect bearing.

Check the operation of loading mechanism and 
 change any defect part

Dismantle the safety cover of the cooling 
 disk.

Check the tightness of cooling disk of the 
 front and rear bearing house.
Dismantle the safety cover of the coupling.

Dismantle the coupling covers and check the 
 two half springs, exchange if it needed.

Check the alignment of the coupling halfs and 
 re alignment it if needed.

If you need any help please 
 look at the major maintenance procedure MPIS doc. no. Fan-004-r0

After successful 
 inspection, operate the fan again, read all the available record value and 
 putted in table (1) to compare between the values before and after inspection.

Technical specification of the Fan
Safety Precautions
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
Safety fence 
 (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,
Wear safety 
 helmet, and safety shoes ... etc
Isolate the circuit breaker for the air fan
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, Feeler gauge.
Suitable lifting device.
Work to be Carried Out
Setting

Check the front /rear bearing and replace the 
 defect bearing.
Check the operation of loading mechanism and 
 change any defect part
Dismantle the safety cover of the cooling 
 disk.
Check the tightness of cooling disk of the 
 front and rear bearing house.
Dismantle the safety cover of the coupling.
Dismantle the coupling covers and check the 
 two half springs, exchange if it needed.
Check the alignment of the coupling halfs and 
 re alignment it if needed.
Re- grease the coupling springs
Check and retighten all bolts
Check every part well.
If you need any help please 
 look at the major maintenance procedure MPIS doc. no. Fan-004-r0
After successful 
 inspection, operate the fan again, read all the available record value and 
 putted in table (1) to compare between the values before and after inspection.
